title: Summative Test 2 — Earth Materials, Hazards & PAGASA

questions.text: What is the difference between a rock and a mineral?
options: Rocks are made of one or more minerals; minerals have a definite chemical composition
Rocks are generally harder than any mineral found in nature
Minerals are always bigger than the rocks that contain them
Rocks are always igneous regardless of where they formed
questions.correct: Rocks are made of one or more minerals; minerals have a definite chemical composition

questions.text: How are igneous rocks formed?
options: Cooling and solidifying of magma or lava
Heat and pressure on existing rocks
questions.correct: Cooling and solidifying of magma or lava

questions.text: Which rock type is formed from heat and pressure on existing rocks?
questions.correct: Metamorphic

questions.text: Which mineral is used to make cement?
questions.correct: Limestone

questions.text: Which soil type is BEST for most crops?
options: Loam — balanced mix of sand, silt, and clay
questions.correct: Loam — balanced mix of sand, silt, and clay

questions.text: Which Philippine province is known for its marble?
questions.correct: Romblon

questions.text: Which type of mining practice helps minimize environmental impact?
options: Sustainable mining with rehabilitation of mined areas
Unregulated open-pit mining without environmental permits
Dumping mining tailings directly into nearby rivers
Clearing forests to make room for wide mining access roads
questions.correct: Sustainable mining with rehabilitation of mined areas

questions.text: What is a tsunami usually caused by?
questions.correct: An underwater earthquake

questions.text: What is the point on Earth's surface directly above an earthquake's origin called?
questions.correct: Epicenter

questions.text: Which of the following is a SLOW geologic process?
questions.correct: Saltwater intrusion

questions.text: What is soil erosion?
options: The gradual removal of topsoil by wind, water, or human activity
questions.correct: The gradual removal of topsoil by wind, water, or human activity

questions.text: Which agency monitors volcanic and seismic activity in the Philippines?
questions.correct: PHIVOLCS

questions.text: What is the BEST response during a strong earthquake?
options: Drop, cover, and hold under a sturdy table
Take an elevator to the ground floor
questions.correct: Drop, cover, and hold under a sturdy table

questions.text: About how many tropical cyclones enter Philippine waters each year?
questions.correct: About 20

questions.text: What causes a storm surge?
options: A typhoon's strong winds and low pressure pushing sea water onto the coast
Underwater earthquakes that displace large volumes of water
Lunar gravitational tides acting alone on the coastline
Volcanic eruptions occurring near coastal population areas
questions.correct: A typhoon's strong winds and low pressure pushing sea water onto the coast

questions.text: Which of the following is the STRONGEST part of a typhoon?
questions.correct: The eyewall

questions.text: Which PAGASA signal number corresponds to winds of 89–117 km/h?
questions.correct: Signal No. 3

questions.text: What is a flash flood?
options: Sudden, fast-rising water — common in mountain areas after heavy rain
questions.correct: Sudden, fast-rising water — common in mountain areas after heavy rain

questions.text: Which of the following is a warning sign of a possible landslide?
options: Cracks in the ground and tilting trees
Bright, sunny weather lasting several days
A sudden increase in the ocean's surface temperature
An unusual presence of birds flying overhead
questions.correct: Cracks in the ground and tilting trees

questions.text: What is the heat index?
options: The 'feels like' temperature combining heat and humidity
questions.correct: The 'feels like' temperature combining heat and humidity

questions.text: What does PAGASA stand for?
options: Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration
Philippine Agency for General Science and Astronomy
Pacific Atmospheric Group of Science Agencies
questions.correct: Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration

questions.text: What does the PAGASA iHEAT map show?
options: Real-time and forecast heat index values across the Philippines
questions.correct: Real-time and forecast heat index values across the Philippines

questions.text: Which heat index range is categorized as DANGER?
What should you do if someone shows signs of heat stroke (confusion, no sweating, high body temp)?
options: Call emergency help and cool the person's body immediately
Wait and observe whether the symptoms improve on their own
Give them coffee to boost their energy and alertness
Let them continue working until they feel better naturally
questions.correct: Call emergency help and cool the person's body immediately

questions.text: What is the urban heat island effect?
options: Cities are hotter than surrounding areas because concrete and asphalt absorb and radiate heat
Islands are always cooler than the mainland
questions.correct: Cities are hotter than surrounding areas because concrete and asphalt absorb and radiate heat

questions.text: Which human activity MOST increases landslide risk?
options: Deforestation on steep hillsides for farming
Planting native trees on hillside slopes
Building houses on flat, low-lying land
Installing solar power systems on rooftops
questions.correct: Deforestation on steep hillsides for farming

questions.text: What is the difference between a hazard and a disaster?
options: A hazard is a natural event; a disaster is when it strikes a vulnerable community
They are exactly the same thing in disaster science
Hazards are always man-made while disasters are natural
Hazards are always catastrophic regardless of location
questions.correct: A hazard is a natural event; a disaster is when it strikes a vulnerable community

questions.text: What is an ipo-ipo?
options: A small, intense rotating column of air — a tornado or waterspout
A type of typhoon that forms over warm ocean waters
A tropical fish that lives in Philippine coastal reefs
A towering rain cloud that produces heavy thunderstorms
questions.correct: A small, intense rotating column of air — a tornado or waterspout

questions.text: Which agency coordinates national disaster response in the Philippines?
questions.correct: NDRRMC

questions.text: Which of the following BEST describes the difference between fast and slow geologic processes?
options: Fast processes happen in seconds to days (like eruptions); slow processes happen over years to centuries (like soil erosion)
Fast processes are always more dangerous than slow ones
Slow processes always cause major disasters when they occur
Fast processes occur only deep underground, not on the surface
questions.correct: Fast processes happen in seconds to days (like eruptions); slow processes happen over years to centuries (like soil erosion)
